description: Upscale a video to higher resolution (2x) for final delivery. Paid render; returns the served URL. A 480p Seedance 2.5 draft: finish_draft (same take, native 1080p). Three engines: the default ('standard') is the safe precision upscaler; engine:'flux' is the FLUX 3 video upscaler (1080p/2K/4K) with an optional mode:'creative' detail-enhancement pass; engine:'detail' rebuilds fine detail such as hair, skin and fabric, the sharpest result for a hero shot and the most expensive. Pick 'flux' or 'detail' when the user asks for added detail rather than a faithful enlargement.

engine.description: default 'standard', the precision upscaler. 'flux' = the FLUX 3 video upscaler. 'detail' = rebuilds fine detail, costs the most

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

mode.description: FLUX only — 'creative' turns on its detail-enhancement pass; default precise

video.description: the source video URL; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: upscale_video
title: Upscale video
